notes.title: The Ice Key is Waiting! v1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has played "A Short Death!"

This is not just a patch but also extra content! You can now find the Ice Key in New Game+, but you'll have to do some platforming and target shooting to earn it. Good luck!

Bug Fixes:
-Stop street from disappearing when door animation was triggered, resulting in a very long fall
-Stop the elevator camera from being active after returning to a checkpoint
-Make the speedrun timer appear if it was previously on
-Hide the Thorny Devil's lopsided shadow when wall-jumping
-Disable narrator tips on New Game+
-Autocam now looks slightly up and down for certain platforming sections

notes.title: v0.99
notes.notes:
-Fixed Speedrun Timer naming to work for saving and loading
-Tiny level collider adjustments to prevent unintended falling

notes.title: v0.97
notes.notes:
Added options for Mumble Dialogue (dialogue becomes meows) and a Speedrun Timer (pauses for dialogue).

-Another patch incoming for fixing Steam Achievements

notes.title: v0.96 Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where incompatible demo save data was recognized by the full game and loaded incomplete data, leading to potential softlock situations.

Small Edits
-reduced jitter caused by truck physics being offset from player physics
-edited the pause menu's checkpoint UI to update on load if unlocked
